subject: Want to build a $1M edu-coding platform for your brand?
content:
Hi Kate,

I'm Jonathan, founder of CodeTribe.
I started Codetribe to help nonprofits in Africa teach kids and teens how to code.

Overtime this grew into a full-scale Computer Science learning platform with easy to use course- and lesson-building for interactive, auto-graded and practical coding projects.

Two Reasons This May Interest You:

1. In 2024 we decided to white-label this and have built an admin dashboard where you add your own logo, catalog and domain name  - This means the ENTIRE PLATFORM on your domain.

2. Ultra Powerful Display Engines:
These are still being fine-tuned, but this means we can offer and easily build custom lesson environments. Think:
 - Specialized block-based lessons
 - Simplified & gamified ( DSL) Python lessons
 - Simulations to teach about AI, SQL, Data Science, databases & much more.

PRICING:

You may be thinking “That sounds too good to be true” or “Probably too expensive.” 

Well, you’ll be pleased to know our focus is on empowering other organizations - Helping YOU grow and serve YOUR customers better.

Our pricing packages are built for flexibility and scale, as you’ll see from just 3 of our CORE packages below:

Monthly CORE Platform:

1,000 users  |  $200 ( $0.20 per user)
3,000 users  |  $480 ( $0.16 per user)
10,000 users  | $960 ( $0.096 per user)

This means that if only 10 of your customers subscribe at $20 p.m. you already break even.

But that’s not all…

OUR ROADMAP - EMPOWERING YOU WITH A.I.

You may recall that I mentioned right at the top our lesson-authoring tools?

We’ve been experimenting with how to allow educators to build the CS and Coding Lessons they want in 10% of the time.
Our initial iterations were bulky, over-complicated and sucked.

To improve results we’ve focused on two things:
1. Making it easier for the models by offering them simpler templates to build on.

2. Creating pre-built lesson environments ( Display Engines) for those templates to plug into.

The result is:
 -  more flexibility and context for A.I. resulting in better, longer and accurate content.
 - Incredibly fun and interactive lessons. ( I will add some examples with screenshots and links in my next email.)

This structure allows teachers to iterate, instruct and tweak new courses with AI if they so desire. Including it as little or much as they want.

IT ONLY GETS BETTER:

A. On-boarding & LMS UI:
Modeled after modern Edtech best practices, the on-boarding UI for Teachers and learners is designed to accommodate multiple classes, topics and teachers.

B. Manage UNLIMITED Schools:
This is by far the most insane part.
We’ve built “Schools” into the white-label. This means you can sign-up dozens of schools and each school is segmented with it’s own name, roster and teachers.
You won’t believe this, but it comes OOTB ( out-of-the-box) at NO EXTRA COST.

So, say you sign-up 10 schools with each 100 students attending Coding Lessons, your cost would STILL be within the CORE 1000 ( $200 p.m.) package.

C. 50% DISCOUNT FOR IMPACT:
For non-profits ANYWHERE and businesses in 121* emerging economies (countries) we offer a no-questions-asked 50% discount on all CORE packages.

*International Co-operative Alliance (ICA) List of developing countries 2024

For national-level or large-scale roll-outs we also have special packages.


I’m sure I’ve missed something, but if this sounds interest to you or someone you know, please forward it this to them & shoot me a reply. 
I’ll be happy to send you our updated priceless and demo videos so you can see it in action.

Have an awesome day.
Jonathan
